sources.title: Human in the Loop: Interactive Passive Automata Learning via Evidence-Driven State-Merging Algorithms
sources.snippet: We present an interactive version of an evidence-driven state-merging (EDSM) algorithm for learning variants of finite state automata. Learning these automata often amounts to recovering or reverse engineering the model generating the data despite noisy, incomplete, or imperfectly sampled data sources rather than optimizing a purely numeric target function.
